description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter, and implements URL path resolution and normalization logic for making relative URLs absolute within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A URL filter class that converts relative URLs to absolute URLs based on a base URI, handling path normalization and special cases.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration data, setting the base URI and preparing the path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Transforms a given URI object into an absolute URI based on the base URI, handling various URI cases.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Resolves '.' and '..' segments in a URL path stack to normalize the path.
